text: {"action": null, "answer": "The first email is from Emily Watson, Chief Marketing Officer at Urban Renewal Properties, requesting a proposal for a video marketing series to showcase their property development projects. The goal is to attract investors and buyers by highlighting sustainability and modern design, with a target launch by the end of the next quarter.\n\nThe second email appears to be a phishing attempt.
